mentions.name: Dedicated hardware music player
mentions.description: A dedicated hardware music player, conceived as the first in a line of single-purpose devices for activities like listening to music and taking notes. The first prototype is being built with a 3D printer.
mentions.problem: Using a smartphone is like opening up a candy box and kills much of the joy and appreciation for what we do on it.
mentions.source_excerpt: My first project is a music player. Making my first prototype with a 3d printer.
